name: Hamelin (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Hamelin (a white church above a millstone on red).
history: Municipal flag of Hameln; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hamelin arms — church and millstone on red
